references.text: The birth of Leah's first four sons: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah.
The birth of Leah's two younger sons: Issachar and Zebulun.
The list of Leah's sons and their descendants who went to Egypt with Jacob.
Jacob's blessings over Leah's sons: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Zebulun, and Issachar.
The names of Israel's sons who came to Egypt, including Leah's sons mentioned in this verse.
The same list of Leah's sons in Genesis and 1 Chronicles confirms the continuity of God's promise to make Jacob's family into a great nation.
Summarizes and expands the event by including Dinah and the total number of children from Leah, highlighting God's faithfulness.
Confirms that the same tribes (Leah's sons) born in Canaan later led the people into Egypt.
Describes the birth of the last son on the list (Zebulun) and emphasizes the theme of God's gift to Leah.
